name: Salamandinay
source: A miko, princess and DRAGON from another world, the "real Earth" which is 500 years into the future. She is quite popular with many people due to her endearing and proactive personality. Also nicknamed "Salako" by Ange, she wishes to return Aura, the original DRAGON, back to their world.
